data.name: Nafseeat
data.gender_notes: Nafseeat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'nafs' meaning 'soul'. The name Nafseeat is given to a girl who is desirable and lovely in the eyes of Allah. The name Nafseeat carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafseeat usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a person's inner world and the depths of their soul, representing their true desires and aspirations
data.etymology: Nafseeat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafseeat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نفسيةت
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من النفس و يعني الصدق و النزاهة
in_arabic.long_meaning: النفسيةت هي اسم عربي مؤنث مشتق من كلمة النفس، و تدل على الصدق و النزاهة و الإخلاص. و هي تعبر عن صفة جميلة في الشخصية الإسلامية، حيث يتصف حامل هذا الاسم بالصدق و الصفاء الداخلي.

in_urdu.name: نفسیت
in_urdu.meaning: نام نفسی معنی صادق و مخلص
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفسیت ایک عربی مؤنث نام ہے جو کہ 'نفس' سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب صادق، مخلص اور صاف دل شخصیت ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں یہ نام صفت کی خوبی کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، جو کہ اندرونی صفائی اور سچائی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नफसीयत
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है सच्चाई और ईमानदारी
in_hindi.long_meaning: नफसीयत एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है सच्चाई, ईमानदारी और आत्म-शुद्धि। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक सुंदर आत्मिक गुण को दर्शाता है, जो व्यक्ति की आंतरिक पवित्रता और सच्चाई को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: نفسیات

in_english.name: Nafseeat
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'Nafs', meaning sincerity and truthfulness
in_english.long_meaning: Nafseeat is a feminine Arabic name derived from 'Nafs', signifying sincerity, truthfulness, and inner purity. In Islamic tradition, it represents a beautiful spiritual quality, reflecting a person's internal honesty and authenticity. The name has roots in Quranic etymology, emphasizing the importance of a pure heart and genuine actions.
